build.beforeDevCommand: cargo build -p jman-cli --release && npm run dev
build.beforeBuildCommand: cargo build -p jman-cli --release && npm run build

security.csp: default-src 'self'; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'; img-src 'self' data:; connect-src ipc: http://ipc.localhost

bundle.longDescription: jman switches the active JDK by re-pointing one stable folder, so terminals and IDEs that are already open pick up the new Java version without a restart.
